Meet

The Maker

RH Designs is a small embroidery studio devoted to the quiet luxury of a well-set table. What began as monogrammed gifts for friends has grown into a small collection of hemstitched cocktail and dinner napkins, plus custom commissions for weddings, showers and homes across the country.

"A monogram turns something beautiful into something that's yours. That's the part I love most."

Each order is stitched one at a time, checked by hand, pressed, and wrapped in tissue and ribbon so it arrives ready to give.

How it's made

From Initial to Heirloom

i.

Choose your piece

Select cocktail or dinner napkins in crisp white linen with a delicate hemstitched border.

ii.

Personalize

Pick your letters, a monogram style and a thread color, from soft blush to deep navy.

iii.

We stitch

Your monogram is embroidered with dense satin stitching, then trimmed and checked by hand.

iv.

Wrapped to give

Pressed, tied with ribbon and packed with a care card. Ships in 7–10 business days.

Our X-Factor

Live Monogram Personalizer

Our X-factor is the live monogram personalizer. Choose a product, pick a monogram style, type your initials and tap a thread color to see a real-time preview, then add it to a bag that remembers your selections across both pages.

Care

Machine wash cold on gentle, or hand wash. Lay flat to dry and press face-down on a towel while slightly damp to keep the monogram raised.

Shipping

Personalized items ship in 7–10 business days. Free shipping on orders over $100.
